title: The Story of the Blue Thread
youtube_title: The Story of the Blue Thread | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: The best answer sometimes starts with hearing the whole thing.
summary: At a bedroom at lamp time, story not started yet, Auntie Luz begins to tell Ines about a story of where the blue thread came from. Ines wants to interrupt with bigger news, but listens all the way to the last sentence, asks one real question, and only then shares something small of their own.
